summary: Master safety improvement initiatives with our 5-day course. Learn ISO 45001, BowTie Analysis, and safety leadership to drive proactive culture.
lede: Leading safety improvement initiatives involves using structured methods to strengthen workplace health and safety practices. This course is for mid-to-senior professionals overseeing safety in complex or high-risk operations who need to plan improvements and communicate progress. Participants practice assessing safety maturity, building performance dashboards, and applying risk-analysis and incident-investigation methods to guide improvement plans.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of workplace health and safety across high-risk and complex industries.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a safety-related or operational management role. Familiarity with basic occupational health and safety concepts is required. No prior experience with ISO 45001 is necessary, though it is beneficial.
